Mark Oshiro chapter 13 quoted hand strike/Queen falling, and awakening refusal; Reactor II Summary explicitly says Tiffany carries the Queen back and warns her; Plugged In confirms banishment and Roland taking Wentworth home. Banishment is an action, not a moral thesis.
